The function doesn't accept "greens". So we cannot fulfill the request with the function. We should respond that we cannot process that request because "greens" is not an available option. Or we could ask if they mean "SALAD" or "SOUP"? But the user specifically says "greens". We can politely say we can't process that request because it's not in the menu. Or we can ask them to choose from the available options. According to the instructions, we should not mention the policy. Just respond. So we respond: "I'm sorry, but we don't have 'greens' on our menu. Please choose from PIZZA, BURGER, SALAD, SOUP, STEAK."
